what: A wide band (SVG) made by joining two copies of the same wave pattern flows straight by one copy’s width in 20s, looping endlessly — the gradient of the wave line (dark segments and white segments) slides along the line like sea waves coming and going, and the overlapping wave faces above the footer flow at different speeds and directions of 20 · 30 · 40s, creating depth

options.--fx-dur: Seconds for one set to pass, default 20s (original wave surfaces 15·30·40s)
options.--fx-dir: If reverse, flows to the right (original fish section wave 30s reverse)
options.--fx-shift: Width of one set, default 50% (when the band has two sets) — px also works, like the original
options.[data-fx-part=strip]: Flowing band — an svg with two copies of the same pattern joined end to end

from.where: shared.css subpage header wave line (original .c-lower-header-surface__wave-gradient svg 6000px gradient wave translateX(−3000px) 20s linear infinite) · index.html About section wave line (20s) · Product section wave surface (30s reverse) · footer overlapping wave surfaces (40s · 15s reverse)
